en.purpose: To classify breast cancer using the TNM system by recording T, N, and M categories and to determine the corresponding AJCC/UICC stage group.
en.use:
Use this guideline to record clinical TNM (cT, cN, cM) for breast cancer and to derive a clinical stage group (0–IV) based on TNM combinations.

Inputs
- cT Primary tumor (TX, T0, Tis, T1-T4) and optional cT subcategories (Tis subcategory, T1 subcategory, T4 subcategory)
- cN Regional lymph nodes (N0-N3) and optional cN subcategories (N2 subcategory, N3 subcategory)
- cM Distant metastasis (M0, M1)
- Optional numeric tumor size (mm) can be used to support selection of T categories

Outputs
- Clinical stage group (0, IA, IIA, IIB, IIIA, IIIB, IIIC, IV) derived from cT/cN/cM
- Clinical TNM assessment (e.g., T2N1M0 or “AnyTN3M0”) and, where applicable, an additional output including selected subcategories (e.g., T1cN2aM0).
en.misuse: Not to be used for recording TNM classification for cancers outside the breast.

other_details.references:
Regionala cancercentrum i samverkan. Nationellt vårdprogram bröstcancer: Kapitel 10 Kategorisering av tumören. Kunskapsbanken, 2025. Available at: https://kunskapsbanken.cancercentrum.se/diagnoser/brostcancer/vardprogram/kvalitetsdokument-for-patologi/

Brierley JD, Gospodarowicz MK, Wittekind C, editors. TNM classification of malignant tumours. 8th ed. Hoboken (NJ): Wiley Blackwell; 2017
other_details.en: A structured guideline used to determine the TNM (Tumour-Node-Metastasis) classification and stage grouping for breast cancer according to the UICC/AJCC TNM system.
